name: Circle of Wildfire
summary: Druids of destruction and renewal who bond with a fiery spirit.

features.name: Circle Spells
features.short: Fire and healing spells that are always prepared.
features.summary: You always have certain spells prepared at the listed druid levels; they don't count against the spells you prepare.

features.name: Summon Wildfire Spirit
features.short: Spend Wild Shape to summon a fiery spirit companion.
features.summary: As an action, expend Wild Shape to summon a wildfire spirit within 30 ft. Creatures within 10 ft. make a DEX save or take 2d6 fire damage. The spirit lasts 1 hour, acts on your turn, can teleport allies with Fiery Teleportation and attacks with Flame Seed.

features.name: Enhanced Bond
features.short: With your spirit out, add 1d8 to fire damage and healing.
features.summary: While your wildfire spirit is summoned, your spells that deal fire damage or restore hit points roll an extra 1d8, and you can cast spells as though from the spirit's space.

features.name: Cauterizing Flames
features.short: Spectral flames from dying creatures heal or burn.
features.summary: When a Small or larger creature dies within 30 ft. of you or your spirit, a flame appears in its space for 1 minute. As a reaction when a creature enters it, you can heal it or deal fire damage equal to 2d10 + WIS. Uses: PB per long rest.

features.name: Blazing Revival
features.short: At 0 HP, your spirit sacrifices itself to bring you back.
features.summary: If your wildfire spirit is within 120 ft. when you drop to 0 hit points, it can drop to 0 itself and you regain half your hit points and stand up. Once per long rest.
